Scan to open on a phone
This is the name your phone and laptop will show when they look for a screen to mirror to.

WINDOWS, MAC, LINUX, CHROMEBOOK
Open the address above in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. The browser will warn that the connection is not private — that is expected, because this TV signs its own certificate. Choose Advanced, then Proceed. Pick a screen or window and press Start.

ANDROID PHONE OR TABLET
Install the BPlay Sender app, pick this TV from the list, enter the PIN.
Or just use the browser — Chrome on Android works too.

IPHONE AND IPAD
Safari cannot capture the screen, so use the BPlay Sender app for iOS (build instructions are in the project README). Photos and videos can be cast from Safari without it.

BLUETOOTH
Bluetooth is used to hand your phone this TV's address and PIN automatically. Video always travels over Wi‑Fi — Bluetooth is far too slow to carry a screen.

NOT WORKING?
Both devices must be on the same Wi‑Fi network, and the network must not have client isolation ("AP isolation") turned on — guest networks usually do.
